info.name: Ecommerce Order & Promotion API
info.description:
Import the matching Ecommerce_Local_Docker environment and select it before sending. Default host is http://localhost:8091 (no /api suffix), matching compose.yaml APP_PORT and .env.example. See postman/README.md for Docker setup, CLI role provisioning, variable lifecycle and full 25-operation coverage matrix.

Use individual functional folders for manual requests. For ordered execution run only Complete E-Commerce Workflow, after registering a dedicated admin setup account and granting administrator using the local CLI. Do not run the entire collection: functional examples deactivate fixtures, logout revokes tokens, optional roles differ, and negative scenarios have explicit prerequisites.

All credentials/tokens are blank in the committed environment. Customer registration generates fresh private credentials on every Send; admin setup generates them only when blank. Captures write to the selected environment; request-local JSON-escaped credential values handle quotes/backslashes safely. Never share/export runtime secrets to Git. Environment values must not be shadowed by Runner data or globals. Public requests use noauth; customer folders use customer_token and admin folders use admin_token.

Amounts use integer minor units; percentage value=1000 means 10% (basis points). Examples and captures require safe JavaScript integers; large bigint data needs lossless JSON handling. Product PATCH stock_adjustment is a signed nonzero delta and is non-idempotent. Checkout is bodyless; Idempotency-Key is generated only when blank and preserved for replay. Cancellation is bodyless, returns 200 on first/repeated healthy cancellation, restores stock once and retains coupon usage.

RBAC permissions: product_manager has products.view-admin/create/update and inventory.adjust; promotion_manager has promotions.view-admin/create/update; administrator has all seven. roles:grant EMAIL ROLE / roles:revoke EMAIL ROLE / admin:grant EMAIL require APP_ENV=local and operate on existing accounts. No HTTP role assignment exists; existing tokens see current role changes.

Redis rate limits apply to all requests, including replay and forbidden attempts. Defaults: register 5/hour/IP; login 30/minute/IP, 5/minute/account+IP, 20/minute/account; public product/health reads 120/minute in separate categories; customer reads 120, cart writes 60, promotions/logout 30, checkout/cancellation 20; shared admin reads120/writes30 per minute/user. On 429 respect Retry-After and preserve checkout key. Limiter outage fails closed with503. Scripts never retry automatically or log secrets.

item.name: Checkout
item.description: Bodyless idempotent checkout. Keep the same key for retry; clear it before a new purchase.

request.description:
Bodyless atomic purchase. Requires customer_token, nonempty purchasable cart and an eligible selected promotion. Generates idempotency_key only when blank; 201 creates, 200 replays the original customer-scoped order. Captures order_id and total. Clear idempotency_key only for a new purchase, never for a retry after an uncertain response. Replay can return a cancelled original order and leaves any refilled cart unchanged.

Expected HTTP [201, 200]. Uses the parent folder bearer token unless overridden.

item.name: Update admin product and adjust stock

request.description:
Partial metadata update: price 2099, status inactive, description cleared, signed stock_adjustment +3. Requires products.update AND inventory.adjust. Omitted fields retained; direct stock_quantity is forbidden. Delta is additive/non-idempotent; every successful resend adds three again. Never blindly retry an uncertain result. Inactive products then disappear publicly. Read Get admin product immediately before PATCH for an authoritative stock baseline; when this is the selected product, the test checks the +3 delta and refreshes the stock capture.

Expected HTTP 200. Uses the parent folder bearer token unless overridden.

request.description:
Reads current cart estimates/availability. Requires customer_token. Prices are current; no inventory reservation. Saves cart_estimated_total_minor for later checkout comparisons. An absent cart has id=null and items=[].

Expected HTTP 200. Uses the parent folder bearer token unless overridden.

exec: pm.test('Required environment variables are configured', () => pm.expect(missing, missing.join(', ')).to.be.empty);

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('10% discount rounds half-up', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.estimated_discount.amount_minor).to.equal(Math.min(Math.floor((d.subtotal.amount_minor * 1000 + 5000) / 10000), 2500)); });

request.description:
Bodyless atomic purchase. Requires customer_token, nonempty purchasable cart and an eligible selected promotion. Generates idempotency_key only when blank; 201 creates, 200 replays the original customer-scoped order. Captures order_id and total. Clear idempotency_key only for a new purchase, never for a retry after an uncertain response. Replay can return a cancelled original order and leaves any refilled cart unchanged.

Expected HTTP [201, 200]. Uses the parent folder bearer token unless overridden.

exec: pm.test('Required environment variables are configured', () => pm.expect(missing, missing.join(', ')).to.be.empty);

if (pm.response.code === 201) pm.test('Controlled workflow checkout matches latest cart estimate', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.total.amount_minor).to.equal(Number(pm.environment.get('cart_estimated_total_minor'))));
